remarks: Experience effortless downtown living in this bright and well-designed studio at 700 Summer Street. The open layout features a stylish kitchen with an island perfect for casual dining, seamlessly connecting to a spacious living area with hardwood floors. A separate south-facing sleeping nook opens to a private 6th-floor balcony, where city skyline views and abundant natural light create an inviting retreat. The unit is finished with a modern, immaculate bathroom and generous double closets for storage. This professionally managed building offers sought-after amenities including a secure lobby, elevators, fitness center, and a beautifully landscaped central courtyard. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are included in the monthly HOA. Ideally located just steps from Stamford's vibrant restaurants, shops, theaters, and UConn Stamford campus, with convenient access to Manhattan by train or car.
